account_custom_field_help.api_path: Path between the address and /table/<name>. /api/now for a plain instance; for an API gateway in front of it, its own context path — empty if the gateway offers the tables directly under the address.
account_custom_field_help.tables: Tables imported as hosts, comma separated. Every record becomes one host. Example: cmdb_ci_unix_server
account_custom_field_help.hostname_field: Field of a record its host is named after (default name). A record with nothing in it is skipped.
account_custom_field_help.rewrite_hostname: Jinja template that builds the hostname, with HOSTNAME as the value of the hostname field and every field of the record available. Example: {{ HOSTNAME }}{% if fqdn %}.{{ fqdn }}{% endif %}
account_custom_field_help.sysparm_query: ServiceNow encoded query limiting which records are read, e.g. operational_status=1. Empty reads every record. It filters records, not fields.
account_custom_field_help.sysparm_fields: Comma separated list of the fields to read. Empty asks for every field of a record — normally what you want.
account_custom_field_help.sysparm_display_value: true delivers readable values (a reference shows the name), false the raw sys_ids, all delivers both.
account_custom_field_help.sysparm_limit: Records per request while paging through a table. Larger means fewer requests, which is what a rate limit cares about.
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_key: Prefix of the inventory attributes the inventorized tables are stored under, e.g. snow. The table name is appended, so every table keeps its own attributes.
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_tables: Tables attached to an existing host instead of imported as hosts, as table:matcher pairs. The matcher is either the record field naming the server, or rel to look the host up in the relationship table. Example: cmdb_ci_cluster:rel, cmdb_ci_network_adapter:cmdb_ci
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_relation_types: Relation types followed by the rel matcher, comma separated, e.g. Contains::Contained by. Empty reads every relation, which is slow on a large instance.
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_host_label: Host label holding the ServiceNow name, used to find the host a record references (default name) — a relation names ldom-s02 while the host may be ldom-s02.example.com. Empty matches the hostname directly.
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_rewrite_parent: Jinja template adapting the referenced name, used only for a CI no host carries under inventorize_host_label.
